resources.string: These changes replace your current configuration. Before applying them, ActionHalo saves one previous configuration on this phone so you can restore it below.

The previous configuration is kept only on this phone until the next import. It contains settings and custom links, and excludes selected text, clipboard contents and diagnostics.
This replaces your current configuration with the saved settings from before the last import. Permission and temporary pause settings are kept.
The configuration from before the last import has been restored.
The previous configuration could not be read or restored. Your saved copy is kept; try importing an exported backup.
The import could not be completed. The previous configuration is kept. Check available storage, then try again.
